findings.claim: Saves with parent= into a missing folder failed because plugin 2.1.1 never sends create_parent. The plan now has the openviking_tools wrapper add create_parent: true to every viking_add_resource call that passes parent, with a stand-in client test for both cases. spike:ov-save-skill/11 shows the 404 without the flag, a 200 that creates both folder levels with it, and no harm when the folder exists.
